route.name: Annecy
route.sub: 6 nights — Moxy Annecy, 2 rooms, direct TGV

blocks.title: MIA — check bags & security
blocks.detail:
• Aer Lingus check-in, Terminal E
• Bags tag straight through to Paris — this is the only check-in of the outbound
• Three hours before departure is right for a holiday-week transatlantic

blocks.title: Early dinner at MIA
blocks.detail:
Likely Terminal: Central
Options: Burger King, Chick Fil-A

blocks.title: Aer Lingus 140 · MIA → DUB (overnight) — BOOKED
blocks.detail:
Duration: 8h15 — 7:05 PM Miami → 8:20 AM Dublin (T2)
Aircraft: Airbus A330-300
Seats: 33H, 33K, 34H, 34K
Meals: hot dinner about 90 min after take-off, wine or beer included; juice before landing. Child meals free but must be booked BY PHONE 48h+ ahead
Luggage: 1 checked bag each, tagged through to Paris
blocks.program: Alaska Mileage Plan — Aer Lingus award

blocks.title: Dublin connection — 1h35
blocks.detail:
• Both flights are Terminal 2; bags are checked through — no baggage hall, no customs
• Follow FLIGHT CONNECTIONS → Irish passport control (non-EU queue, or the e-gates if offered to US passports) → transfer security (hand-bag X-ray: empty water bottles, liquids under 100 ml) → gate
• Transatlantic flights use the T2 400-gates. EI 524 normally leaves from the 400-gates too; if the screens show a 100- or 200-gate that is Terminal 1, a 10–15 minute walk by the internal link
• Allow 45–60 minutes for the process, then buy lunch airside to eat on EI 524 — there is no meal on board and nothing to buy at CDG before immigration
blocks.flag: 1h35 is above Aer Lingus's published 90-minute minimum for a same-ticket connection; if EI 140 is late, Aer Lingus rebooks you on the next Paris flight. Go straight to passport control first.

blocks.title: Aer Lingus 524 · DUB → CDG
blocks.detail:
Duration: 1h50 — 9:55 AM Dublin → 12:45 PM Paris CDG Terminal 1
Aircraft: Airbus A320
Seats: 20A, 20B, 20C, 20D
Meals: none — eat what you bought airside in Dublin
Luggage: checked bags already through to Paris
blocks.notes: Same ticket as EI 140.

blocks.title: CDG Terminal 1 — passport control & bags
blocks.detail:
• Ireland is outside Schengen, so this is a full external-border arrival
• EU Entry/Exit System: passport scan, photo and fingerprints for the adults; children under 12 are photo and scan only
• Baggage claim and the arrivals hall are on Level 5
• Typical: 45–60 minutes from the gate to the arrivals hall
blocks.flag: T1 queues of 60–90 minutes have been reported at peak since EES started. If it runs long, everything after shifts; the evening still fits because dinner has no fixed sitting time.

blocks.title: Taxi rank — Level 5, Exit 24
blocks.detail:
• Official rank is on the arrivals level (Level 5), Exit 24, past the car-rental desks
• Use the marked rank only — ignore anyone offering a ride in the hall
• Ask for a van (monospace) so all four and the bags fit in one car

blocks.title: Taxi CDG → Hyatt Regency Paris Étoile
blocks.detail:
• Regulated flat rate: €56 to the Right Bank (Porte Maillot, 17th), up to 4 passengers, luggage included, no surcharges
• 30 km by the A1 and the périphérique, 40–45 minutes at this hour
• Card accepted; the fare is fixed, not metered
blocks.notes: €56 flat rate, tariff of 1 Feb 2026.

blocks.title: Check in — Hyatt Regency Paris Étoile, 4 nights, 2 rooms — BOOKED
blocks.detail:
• 3 Place du Général Kœnig, 75017 Paris
• Check-in from 15:00; early check-in requested on 31438883
• Ask for connecting or adjoining rooms
• Métro 1, RER C and RER E directly underneath
blocks.roomType: 2 × Twin room (2 twin beds), 1 adult + 1 child each
blocks.notes: Two reservations, 60,000 points each. Checkout 12:00. City tax €8.45 per person aged 13+ per night — €67.60 for the stay, paid at checkout.
blocks.flag: Confirm at check-in that breakfast covers both rooms.

blocks.title: Rooms — shower, unpack, rest
blocks.detail: • Showers, unpack, change for the evening

blocks.title: Walk — Grande Armée to the Arc de Triomphe
blocks.detail:
• Straight down avenue de la Grande Armée from the hotel door — 1.1 km, flat, 14 minutes
• Sunset is 16:54, so the Arc and the top of the Champs-Élysées are lit when you arrive
• On to the restaurant round the Étoile and up avenue de Wagram, 8 minutes

blocks.title: Dinner — Hippopotamus Wagram
blocks.detail:
• 46 avenue de Wagram, 75008 — French steakhouse chain: burgers, steak-frites, chicken, fish & chips
• Continuous service 11:30–00:30; book the table for 17:30
• Menu enfant €8.90 to age 10: mini steak haché, kids' cheeseburger, nuggets or fish & chips, plus dessert and a drink
• Adults: Steak Hippo €13.90, bavette €16.90, burgers €15.90–19.90, one side and one sauce included
• Reserve online (link in notes) or call 01 46 22 13 96
blocks.notes: About €70 for four. Service and VAT are already in the menu price; tipping is optional — round up or leave a few euros. Reserve: https://bookings.zenchef.com/results?rid=204082&pid=1001

blocks.title: Walk to Mac & Tea
blocks.detail: • Up to Place des Ternes and down rue de Montenotte — 450 m, 6 minutes

blocks.title: Crêpes — Mac & Tea
blocks.detail:
• 19 avenue Mac-Mahon, 75017 — crêpe counter, made to order, open to midnight
• Butter-sugar €5, Nutella €6.50, Nutella-banana €8.50, salted caramel with vanilla ice cream €7.60
• Bubble waffle with ice cream €8; bubble tea €9
• No website — 01 45 71 52 76
blocks.notes: About €30 for four crêpes and drinks.

blocks.title: Walk to the hotel
blocks.detail: • Down avenue des Ternes to Porte Maillot — 1.0 km, 14 minutes, flat and lit the whole way
blocks.flag: Hotel by 19:45.

days.title: Eiffel Tower, Trocadéro at dusk & a Seine dinner cruise

blocks.title: Breakfast — hotel
blocks.detail: • Included

blocks.title: RER C · Neuilly–Porte Maillot → Champ de Mars–Tour Eiffel
blocks.detail:
• Station is under the hotel. 17 minutes on the train, about 30 minutes door to door including both walks
• Trains every 15 minutes
• €2.55 per adult, children 4–9 half price

blocks.title: Eiffel Tower — 2nd floor, then 1st floor
blocks.detail:
• Timed lift tickets for 10:00: €23.50 adult, €6 child aged 4–11 = €59 for four
• Arrive about 15 minutes before the slot. Earlier only means waiting outside, and more than 20 minutes late is not guaranteed entry
• Security check, lift to the 2nd floor for the views, then down to the 1st floor for the glass floor and the Christmas winter terrace
• Lift tickets go on sale 60 days ahead at midnight Paris time — 19 October. They sell out
blocks.flag: Not the summit: a second lift, a second queue, and wind at 276 m in December. The 2nd floor is the right height with a 5-year-old.

blocks.title: Lunch — La Boulangerie Effel
blocks.detail:
• 26 rue de Monttessuy, 75007 — 170 m from the tower, 2 minutes
• Artisan bakery with a sit-down room, open every day 7:00 to midnight
• Lunch set €12.90: one savoury dish, one sweet, one drink
• Croque-monsieur €6.50, quiche lorraine €5.50, jambon-beurre €5.50, hot chocolate €3.80
blocks.notes: About €45 for four. Book a table on OpenTable if you want seats held: https://boulangerieffelparis.com/en/

blocks.title: RER C back · Pont de l'Alma → Neuilly–Porte Maillot
blocks.detail:
• Pont de l'Alma is the nearest station — 600 m along rue de Monttessuy and avenue Rapp, 8 minutes
• Same line back, 18 minutes; about 30 minutes door to door

blocks.title: Rest at the hotel
blocks.detail:
• Still on Miami time, and the cruise gets you back at 20:15
• Change before leaving: casual, no sportswear or trainers

blocks.title: Bus 82 · Porte Maillot → Trocadéro
blocks.detail:
• One bus, no change, no stairs. 16 minutes on board, about 26 minutes door to door
• Stop is on Place du Trocadéro itself
• €2 per adult — the bus fare, not the métro ticket

blocks.title: Trocadéro — the tower lit, and the 5 o'clock sparkle
blocks.detail:
• The terrace between the two wings of the Palais de Chaillot: the full-height view
• Sunset 16:55. The lights come on at dusk and the tower sparkles for 5 minutes at 17:00
• Free

blocks.title: Walk down to Port de la Bourdonnais
blocks.detail: • Through the Trocadéro gardens, across Pont d'Iéna, then left along the river — 1.1 km, 15 minutes, downhill then flat

blocks.title: Check in and board — the desk closes at 18:00
blocks.detail:
• Bateaux Parisiens desk at Port de la Bourdonnais, at the foot of the tower
• Be at the desk by 17:50; boarding is straight after, and the boat sails at 18:15

blocks.title: Dinner cruise — Bateaux Parisiens, Service Étoile
blocks.detail:
• Sails 18:15, alongside again at 19:30
• Kir, starter, main and dessert; children's menu for under-12s
• €99 adult, €40 child to age 11 = €278 for four, booked online
• Dress: casual — no shorts, flip-flops or sportswear
blocks.flag: The 18:15 sailing is the only one that works with the kids — the other dinner cruise runs 20:30 to 23:00.

blocks.title: Bus 82 back to the hotel
blocks.detail: • Off the boat by 19:40, Tour Eiffel stop two minutes away, straight through to Porte Maillot — about 30 minutes
blocks.flag: Hotel by 20:15.

days.title: Versailles — the Palace, the Gardens and the Coach Gallery

blocks.title: Breakfast — hotel
blocks.detail: • Included

blocks.title: RER C · Neuilly–Porte Maillot → Versailles Château Rive Gauche
blocks.detail:
• 09:45 from Neuilly–Porte Maillot, change at Champ de Mars–Tour Eiffel, arrive Versailles 10:35 — 59 minutes
• Same line throughout; the change is the station you used for the Eiffel Tower
• €2.55 per adult, children 4–9 half price
blocks.flag: On a Saturday every route is 1h08–1h15 door to door. The 39-minute option via La Défense uses Transilien line U, which runs weekdays only — it does not exist on 19 December. RER C is the pick because it is one line, the change is a station you already know, and Rive Gauche is the closest station to the gates.

blocks.title: Walk to the Palace
blocks.detail: • About 15 minutes from the station up avenue du Général de Gaulle and across the Place d'Armes to Entrance A

blocks.title: Palace of Versailles — State Apartments & Hall of Mirrors
blocks.detail:
• Timed slot 11:00. Arrive on the slot, not early — you wait outside otherwise. Palace ticket €21 per adult; UNDER 18s ARE FREE but still need a free timed ticket booked in the same order — €42 for the four of you
• Security at Entrance A, then the King's and Queen's State Apartments, the Hall of Mirrors, the Royal Chapel
• Low-season hours 09:00–17:30, closed Mondays
• Book on chateauversailles.fr — Saturdays sell out
blocks.flag: Not the Passport (€25 each): it adds the Trianon estate, which is a 2 km walk across the park and does not open until 12:00. Wrong buy in December with a 5-year-old.

blocks.title: Garden terrace & the Grand Canal view
blocks.detail:
• Straight out of the palace onto the terrace: the Water Parterre, then the view down the length of the Grand Canal
• Gardens are free in winter — the Musical Fountains season ends 31 October
• Statues are boxed up for the winter and the fountains are off

blocks.title: Walk to lunch
blocks.detail: • Out of the Place d'Armes and into the Saint-Louis quarter — about 12 minutes

blocks.title: Lunch — Blé Noir
blocks.detail:
• 9 rue de Satory, 78000 Versailles — Breton crêperie, 4.7 from over 5,000 reviews
• Continuous service, so 13:00 is no problem
• Savoury buckwheat galettes about €10, sweet crêpes about €7, cider and juices €3–5
• Reserve: 01 39 53 39 09
blocks.notes: About €47 for four.

blocks.title: Walk to the Coach Gallery
blocks.detail: • Back to the Place d'Armes — the Great Stables are the building facing the palace

blocks.title: Gallery of Coaches — free
blocks.detail:
• Ground floor of the Great Stables, Place d'Armes, opposite the palace gates
• Royal carriages, sleighs and sedan chairs, including Charles X's coronation coach
• FREE, and open weekends only in winter: 12:30–18:30, last entry 17:45
• Indoors and warm, which the gardens are not

blocks.title: Walk to Versailles Château Rive Gauche
blocks.detail: • 10 minutes back down avenue du Général de Gaulle

blocks.title: RER C back to the hotel
blocks.detail:
• 16:55 from Versailles Château Rive Gauche, one change, hotel at 17:52 — 57 minutes
• The next one is 17:10, hotel 18:07

blocks.title: Rest at the hotel
blocks.detail: • Coats and boots off after a long day out of the city

blocks.title: Walk to dinner
blocks.detail: • 8 rue Saint-Ferdinand — 8 minutes via avenue de la Grande Armée

blocks.title: Dinner — Amalfitana
blocks.detail:
• 8 rue Saint-Ferdinand, 75017 — Italian, family-run, relaxed
• Dinner service from 19:00; closed Sunday
• Pizzas €12.50–19, pasta €12–18, starters €8–16, desserts €7–10
• No children's menu, but a pizza splits between the two kids
• Reserve: 01 45 72 15 04
blocks.notes: About €70 for four.

blocks.title: Walk back to the hotel
blocks.detail: • 8 minutes
blocks.flag: Hotel by 20:30.

days.title: Montmartre, the Tuileries Christmas market & the Champs-Élysées lights

blocks.title: Breakfast — hotel
blocks.detail: • Included

blocks.title: Métro 1 + 2, then the funicular · Porte Maillot → Sacré-Cœur
blocks.detail:
• Métro 1 to Charles de Gaulle–Étoile, one stop, then Métro 2 direction Nation to Anvers — about 37 minutes door to door on a Sunday
• Up rue de Steinkerque, then the funicular instead of the 200 steps
• The funicular takes a standard métro ticket: €2.55 adult, €1.30 child

blocks.title: Sacré-Cœur & the terrace
blocks.detail:
• Entry is free; the basilica is open 06:30–22:30 daily
• The terrace in front is the free view over the whole city
• Sunday mass is at 11:00 — be out of the nave by then
• Dome climb skipped: €26 for four, 280 steps, no lift

blocks.title: Place du Tertre & the back streets
blocks.detail:
• Street artists on the square, then rue de l'Abreuvoir, the vineyard and the Wall of Love
• All free

blocks.title: Walk down to lunch
blocks.detail: • Downhill to boulevard de Clichy — about 12 minutes

blocks.title: Lunch — Bouillon Pigalle
blocks.detail:
• 22 boulevard de Clichy, 75018 — open 7 days, 12:00–00:00
• Œuf mayonnaise €2.50, onion soup €3.90, sausage & mash €9.60, bœuf bourguignon €12.20, steak-frites €12.60, duck confit €12.80
• Fries €3.00, rice pudding €2.80, crème brûlée €3.80, soft drinks €1.10–2.60
• No children's menu — sausage and mash at €9.60 is the children's dish
• No reservations. Arriving at 12:15 on a Sunday means a short queue
blocks.notes: About €60–68 for four.

blocks.title: Métro 2 + 1 · Pigalle → Tuileries
blocks.detail:
• Pigalle station is two minutes from the door. Métro 2 to Charles de Gaulle–Étoile, change to Métro 1 to Tuileries
• About 35 minutes door to door

blocks.title: Tuileries Christmas Market — La Magie de Noël
blocks.detail:
• Jardin des Tuileries, north side, 1st arrondissement — free entry
• About 100 chalets, a carousel, a toddler train, bumper cars and fun houses
• Rides about €3–5 per child; pick two rather than working down the row
• Skipping the Ferris wheel: €15 for four and the queue is the longest thing there
• Goûter from the chalets — crêpes €5–7, churros €5, hot chocolate
blocks.flag: 2026–27 dates are not published yet. The 2025–26 edition ran 15 Nov – 4 Jan, so your dates almost certainly fall inside — re-check in November. Fallback: the La Défense market, confirmed 12 Nov – 31 Dec 2026, four stops on Métro 1.

blocks.title: Walk — Tuileries to Place de la Concorde
blocks.detail: • West out of the gardens past the obelisk — 10 minutes, flat

blocks.title: Champs-Élysées Christmas illuminations
blocks.detail:
• Lights switch on at 17:00 and run to midnight
• Walk up from Concorde as far as Franklin D. Roosevelt, about 900 m, with the lit trees down both sides and the Arc at the far end
• Free

blocks.title: Métro 1 · Franklin D. Roosevelt → Porte Maillot
blocks.detail:
• Direct, no change, about 20 minutes door to door
• The station exit is at the hotel

blocks.title: Walk to dinner
blocks.detail: • 212 bis boulevard Pereire — 10–15 minutes from the hotel

blocks.title: Dinner — Il Grano
blocks.detail:
• 212 bis boulevard Pereire, 75017 — 10–15 minutes on foot from the hotel
• Open Sunday 11:30–22:30, which rules most of the 17th out tonight
• Pinsa romana and pizza €13.50–19.50, pasta €18–23, desserts €7.50–11
• Reserve: 01 58 57 99 46
blocks.notes: About €70–85 for four.
blocks.flag: Closed Sunday nearby, so do not default to them: Amalfitana, Le Paris 17, Crêperie L'Étoile d'Or.

blocks.title: Repack for the mountains
blocks.detail:
• Winter gear and snow clothes to the top of the bags
• Tomorrow is a direct TGV to Annecy from Gare de Lyon at 09:46

blocks.title: Breakfast — Regency Club
blocks.detail:
• Included
• Lunch is not until about 14:00 in Annecy

blocks.title: Checkout
blocks.detail: • Confirm the taxi at the door

blocks.title: Taxi · hotel → Gare de Lyon
blocks.detail:
• Métro 1 goes there direct in ~25 minutes, but with four people and winter luggage in Monday rush hour the taxi is the right call
• About €25–30, metered

blocks.title: Gare de Lyon — snacks for the train
blocks.detail:
• TGV INOUI to Annecy: check the departure board for the hall — Halls 1 and 2 are side by side
• Monop'Daily (Hall 2, level 0) or Paul for pastries, fruit and drinks
• Platform posts about 20 minutes before departure

blocks.title: TGV INOUI · Paris Gare de Lyon → Annecy
blocks.detail:
• DIRECT, 3h43, no changes — published timetable for Monday 21 December (also 06:45→10:38 and 12:46→16:34)
• Domestic TGV, so the Carte Avantage price cap applies: adults never pay more than €89
• Bar car for hot drinks; reserved seats — book four together
• Annecy station exit → the hotel is a five-minute walk
blocks.notes: Budgeted at $215 for four with the Carte Avantage. Floor about $150 at opening-day advance fares; ceiling about $270 at the cap. Sales for these dates open on 30 September — book that morning.
blocks.flag: Sales open 30 September — book that morning, on an exchangeable fare.

blocks.title: Walk to the Moxy
blocks.detail:
• 19 avenue du Rhône — five minutes from the station, flat
• Check-in is 15:00: drop the bags at the desk (the bar IS the front desk) and go to lunch

blocks.title: Bags down — Moxy Annecy, 2 rooms, 6 nights
blocks.detail:
• 19 avenue du Rhône, 74000 Annecy — five minutes from the station AND five from the old town; the day-trip buses leave from beside the station
• TWO ROOMS, one adult + one child each: rooms are 17 m² (183 ft²), max two people, queen or twin. Ask for adjoining or same-floor rooms when you book, and again on arrival
• Check-in 15:00, CHECKOUT 12:00 — which makes the last morning easy
• Bar Moxy: coffee, drinks and small plates all day; restaurant Tue–Sat 19:00–21:30
• No kitchen, no included breakfast — the bakery is five minutes away
blocks.nights: 6 nights (Mon Dec 21 – Sun Dec 27) · Room 2 of 2 — CASH
blocks.roomType: Twin guest room, 2 twin beds (1 adult + 1 child)
blocks.notes: Your quote: €574 for all six nights — about $666, plus taxe de séjour of roughly €1.50 per adult per night. Budgeted $680.
blocks.flag: Confirm at booking that a 5- or 7-year-old counts within the 2-person maximum (it does at most Moxys) and that the two rooms can be adjoining.

blocks.title: Room 1 — points + free-night award
blocks.detail:
• Same hotel, second twin room for the other adult + child
• Nights of 21–25 December (five nights): 166,000 Marriott Bonvoy points
• Night of 26 December: one Free Night Award certificate
• Two reservations — ask the hotel to LINK them so you keep the same room and are not asked to move on the 26th
blocks.nights: 6 nights (Mon Dec 21 – Sun Dec 27) · Room 1 of 2 — POINTS + FREE NIGHT
blocks.roomType: Twin guest room, 2 twin beds (1 adult + 1 child)
blocks.notes: 166,000 points for five nights plus a Free Night Award for the sixth. The $10 is the taxe de séjour on a points stay.
blocks.flag: Confirm at booking that the certificate's point value covers the 26th (a Saturday in Christmas week) — if the night prices above the certificate, Marriott lets you top up with points.

blocks.title: Lunch — Les Burgers de Papa
blocks.detail:
• 11 rue Président Favre — three minutes, on the way into town
• No booking: burger menus from €9.90, combo €14.50
blocks.notes: About €40–45 for four. No published children's menu, but a plain burger and fries splits easily.

blocks.title: Back to the Moxy — check in properly
blocks.detail: • Rooms ready from 15:00 — unpack, then out while it is light

blocks.title: Old town on foot — canals, Palais de l'Isle, Pont des Amours
blocks.detail:
• Rue Sainte-Claire under the arcades, the Thiou canal, the Palais de l'Isle from the bridge
• Out to the Jardins de l'Europe and across the Pont des Amours to Le Pâquier: swans, ducks, the lake with the mountains behind
• Dark by about 16:50
• All free, all within ten minutes of the hotel

blocks.title: Noël des Alpes — the market after dark
blocks.detail:
• 135+ artisan chalets from Quai de Vicenza through Place Saint-Maurice to the Jardins de l'Europe, plus Santa at Place de l'Ancienne Grenette
• FREE entry. Illuminations on the old town, vin chaud for the adults, chocolat chaud for the kids
• Natural outdoor ICE RINK (about 450 m²) in the Jardins de l'Europe — you skate here on the 23rd
• 2025–26 edition ran 29 Nov – 4 Jan, 11:00–21:00 (21:30 Fri/Sat and holidays)
blocks.flag: 2026–27 dates are not yet published — the city posts them in October/November. Every recent edition has covered your dates.

blocks.title: Carrefour City — water & snacks for the rooms
blocks.detail:
• 14 avenue de Chambéry, by the station — two minutes from the hotel. Mon–Sat 07:00–20:50, Sunday 09:00–12:50
• Water, fruit, biscuits, juice for the rooms
• Monoprix (65 rue Carnot) is the bigger shop if you need it — closed Sundays

blocks.title: Dinner — Brasserie des Européens
blocks.detail:
• Esplanade de l'Hôtel de Ville — five minutes, beside the Pâquier
• Open every day for lunch and dinner, which is why it is Monday's pick: several old-town kitchens close Mon–Tue
• Classic brasserie — steak-frites, fish, salads
• Reserve: 04 50 45 00 81
blocks.notes: About €70–80 for four. No published children's menu — ask; brasseries of this kind almost always do a plat enfant around €10–12.

days.title: Le Semnoz — sledging above the lake, 25 minutes by taxi

blocks.title: Breakfast — Pain et Copains
blocks.detail:
• 42 rue Vaugelas, five minutes — opens 06:30 Tue–Sat
• Croissants, pains au chocolat, coffee, juice; sit in or take back to the rooms
• Buy the packed lunch for the mountain here too if you would rather not eat at the top

blocks.title: Taxi · Moxy → Semnoz Alpin
blocks.detail:
• About 25 minutes up the mountain road — book the night before: Taxi74 06 64 12 58 66 or the hotel desk
• Ask for a return pick-up at 15:00 from the same spot, or take the driver's number
• Metered, prefecture-regulated: roughly €35–55 each way
• Bus alternative: line S2 from Annecy Gare, €2 a head, 60 minutes
blocks.notes: Budgeted at €100 for the round trip. If the S2 bus appeals for one direction, the 15:45 down from Semnoz Alpin gets you home by 16:45 and saves about €45.

blocks.title: Semnoz — the sledging slopes
blocks.detail:
• 1,450–1,700 m, open ground above the tree line
• FREE toboggan piste with safety nets and two free conveyor lifts
• Sledge hire at the Nordic Forest chalet: €5 for a half-day (09:00–13:00), €8 all day. No booking
• SNOW TUBING: a 60 m track beside the sledging area, from age 3, on a points card (1 point = 2 runs, cards from about €4)
• Open 09:00–17:00 when the station is open
blocks.notes: Three sledges at €8 plus a tubing card — about €45.
blocks.flag: SNOW RECORD: Semnoz was shut over Christmas in 2018 (from 24 Dec) and 2022 (from 22 Dec, sledging area included); it opened on time in 2023 and just in time (21 Dec) in 2024. Check semnoz.fr's live status the night before. IF IT IS SHUT: swap this day with Thursday — Le Grand-Bornand's upper area has snowmaking and opened 7–16 December in every one of those years.

blocks.title: Lunch — Le 1407, Semnoz Alpin
blocks.detail:
• The snack-restaurant at the top station (the old 'Chez JP'), at the foot of the Bauges-side slopes
• Daily-changing Savoyard plates, croque-monsieur, chips, hot chocolate — warm room, big windows
• Alternative with a published children's menu: Le Châtillon, lower on the Viuz side — menu enfant €10, tartiflette €18.50
blocks.notes: About €45–50 for four. Mountain-snack pricing, expect €12–16 a plate.

blocks.title: Second run — snow play until the taxi
blocks.detail:
• Back on the sledges, or snowmen and snowball fights on the open ground
• Stop at 14:45; the taxi is at 15:00

blocks.title: Taxi · Semnoz Alpin → Moxy
blocks.detail: • 25 minutes

blocks.title: Back at the hotel — dry everything out
blocks.detail:
• No radiators or drying room: boots opened out with paper inside, gloves and hats on the hairdryer, socks over the shower rail
• Ask the desk for a drying rack

blocks.title: Market at dusk — Santa, crêpes & chocolat chaud
blocks.detail:
• Santa's chalet at Place de l'Ancienne Grenette; crêpes and hot chocolate under the arcades
• Lights on from about 16:50

blocks.title: Dinner — Le Fréti
blocks.detail:
• 12 rue Sainte-Claire, in the arcades of the old town — six minutes on foot
• Savoyard — fondue and raclette
• Plat du jour €11–15; full fondue menus €25 and up per adult; MENU ENFANT €12.50
• Reserve: 04 50 51 29 52 — it fills every winter evening
blocks.notes: About €80 for four with one shared fondue and two children's menus.
blocks.flag: Weekly closure day not published — confirm when you book, and ask about the 24th and 26th while you are on the phone.

days.title: Annecy — château, lake & the market rink

blocks.title: Breakfast — Pain et Copains
blocks.detail: • Everything today is within ten minutes on foot

blocks.title: Château d'Annecy
blocks.detail:
• Up the hill from the old town — ten minutes, steepish
• Winter hours 10:00–12:30 and 14:00–17:30. CLOSED TUESDAYS and 24–25 December — which is why it is today
• €6.50 adult, UNDER-12s FREE — €13 for the family
• Lake archaeology, medieval rooms, the ramparts — 60–90 minutes is enough
• The tourist office runs a family trail, 'Le château à petits pas' — ask at the desk

blocks.title: Lunch — La Bolée crêperie
blocks.detail:
• 41 rue Carnot, old town, since 1979 — four minutes down from the château
• Savoury galettes, sweet crêpes
• Open Tue–Sat 11:45–22:30. Closed Sunday and Monday
blocks.notes: About €45–50 for four. Prices not published online — crêperie pricing, galettes €9–14.

blocks.title: Le Pâquier & the lakefront
blocks.detail:
• Across the Pont des Amours to the big lakeside meadow — swans, ducks, room to run
• Flat, free

blocks.title: Ice skating — the market rink, Jardins de l'Europe
blocks.detail:
• The Noël des Alpes outdoor rink, about 450 m², in the gardens
• Skate hire on site
blocks.notes: Price not published — market rinks of this size run €5–8 with skates. Budgeted at €25 for four.
blocks.flag: Indoor alternative: Patinoire Jean Régis, 90 chemin des Fins, 04 50 57 56 02 — you go there on Saturday anyway.

blocks.title: Goûter — crêpes & chocolat chaud
blocks.detail: • A market chalet or any café on Place Saint-Maurice

blocks.title: Noël des Alpes — chalets and Santa
blocks.detail:
• Santa's chalet at Place de l'Ancienne Grenette; artisan chalets along Quai de Vicenza and rue du Collège-Chappuisien
• Tomorrow the chalets close early (about 19:00)

blocks.title: Dinner — Le Napoli
blocks.detail:
• 8 rue du Pâquier — four minutes from the hotel
• Pizza and pasta, about twenty pizzas, lasagne, veal; states an 'adapted children's menu'
• Open daily except Sunday in winter
• Reserve: 04 50 51 76 06
blocks.notes: About €55–60 for four. Children's menu price not published — ask when booking.

days.title: Le Grand-Bornand — village sledging & tubing, then Christmas Eve

blocks.title: Breakfast — Pain et Copains, and the mountain snacks
blocks.detail:
• Opens 06:30
• Buy a sandwich each and snacks for the slopes
• Snow gear on; spare gloves and socks in the bag

blocks.title: Walk to the gare routière
blocks.detail:
• The coach station is 50 m to the right as you leave the railway station — five minutes from the hotel
• Ticket office is 10 m from the station exit; or buy on the bus (CASH, exact change), or online at Altibus

blocks.title: Bus Y62 · Annecy → Le Grand-Bornand village
blocks.detail:
• ARVI Mobilité lines Y62/Y63, about 1h10 via Thônes and Saint-Jean-de-Sixt
• School-holiday weekday departures cluster at 08:00, 08:25, 08:55, 09:25 — take the one closest to 08:30 on the December sheet
• €8.60 single / €16 return per adult; children's fare not published — budget €50 for four
• Get off at Le Grand-Bornand VILLAGE (not Chinaillon): the sledging areas and the Rosay gondola are here
blocks.notes: Same bus continues to La Clusaz. The upper area has snowmaking and opened 7–16 December in each of the last three winters.
blocks.flag: Christmas Eve runs on a holiday timetable — confirm the return departures on the December sheet before you set out. Aim to be on a bus by 15:30.

blocks.title: La Grenouille — village sledging
blocks.detail:
• 'La Grenouille au Borne': a sunny, gently sloping sledging area in the heart of the village, built for the little ones. FREE, open daily in season, helmets advised
• No lift, no ticket
• Second free area, L'Abeille at Venay, if this one is busy
• Sledge hire from the village sports shops — about €5–10 for the day

blocks.title: Snack — the bakery bag
blocks.detail: • The bakery sandwiches — lunch is not until 13:00

blocks.title: Rosay gondola → snow tubing & La Marmotte
blocks.detail:
• PEDESTRIAN ticket on the Rosay gondola: €7.70 return per person aged 5–74, UNDER-5s FREE — €23.10 for the four of you
• At the top: the SNOW-TUBING TRACK (from age 3; two tube sizes, split at 120 cm) and 'La Marmotte', a 2,600 m² sledging area inside the beginners' zone
• Reliable snow at 1,300 m+
blocks.notes: Gondola €23.10 plus tubing. Tubing price per session is NOT published — budget €30 for the kids and confirm at the ticket office.
blocks.flag: Confirm the tubing track is open on 24 December — it is listed as seasonal but not date-by-date.

blocks.title: Lunch — Pizzeria Casanova, Le Grand-Bornand
blocks.detail:
• In the village, a few minutes from the gondola base
• MENU ENFANT €10 (tartiflette + lollipop + ice cream), burgers €12, pâtes bornandine €13, pizzas to €15
• No booking needed
blocks.notes: About €50 for four.

blocks.title: The village — church square, Christmas lights, a last slide
blocks.detail:
• Le Grand-Bornand is a working Savoyard village, not a purpose-built resort: the baroque church, wooden chalets, reblochon shops
• One last run at La Grenouille if there is energy
• Bus stop is in the village centre — be there ten minutes early

blocks.title: Bus Y62 · Le Grand-Bornand → Annecy
blocks.detail:
• Return leg of the same ticket
• Back at the gare routière about 16:40, five minutes from the hotel

blocks.title: Market stop — crêpes on the way home
blocks.detail:
• Five minutes from the coach station into the market; the chalets close early on the 24th (about 19:00)
• Bridges the gap to a 19:15 dinner

blocks.title: Back at the hotel — dry out, dress up
blocks.detail:
• Wet gear opened out across both rooms (hairdryer on gloves and hats, socks on the shower rail), everyone through the shower, then into something decent for Christmas Eve
• Presents organised for the morning — split between the two rooms

blocks.title: Christmas Eve dinner
blocks.detail:
• Annecy restaurants run FIXED festive menus on the 24th and they sell out. Book in November, when annecy-ville.fr publishes the year's list
• Confirmed to open 24 Dec in recent years, with prices: Ô Bon Bec (€110 adult, €45 child 5–11 — the one with a real children's price), Le Clocher in Annecy-le-Vieux (€68, five courses), Brasserie Bocuse Irma on the lake (€82/€86)
• Cheaper route: Le Fréti or Le Ramoneur Savoyard if either serves a normal card on the 24th — ask when you book Tuesday's table
blocks.notes: Budgeted at €215 for four — two adult festive menus at about €80 plus two children at about €25–45. Ô Bon Bec at €310 is the ceiling.
blocks.flag: A five-course menu starting at 19:30 ends after 21:30. Book the EARLIEST sitting offered, and ask whether the children's menu can be served fast.

days.title: Christmas Day — presents, the lake, a Savoyard lunch

blocks.title: Presents & a slow breakfast
blocks.detail:
• No fixed start. Presents across the two rooms, then breakfast at Bar Moxy (the bar serves from early) or the pastries you bought on the 24th
• Assume every shop and most bakeries are shut today

blocks.title: Christmas morning on the lake
blocks.detail:
• Pont des Amours, the Jardins de l'Europe, out along the Pâquier
• Free, ten minutes from the door

blocks.title: Christmas lunch — Le Ramoneur Savoyard
blocks.detail:
• 7 rue Grenette, old town — six minutes on foot
• Savoyard set menus €21–33.50 per adult; MENU ENFANT 'P'tits Malins' €12.90
• Reserve: 04 50 51 29 03 — and ask specifically whether they open on the 25th at midday; some set menus are excluded on public holidays
blocks.notes: About €95 for four. UPGRADE OPTION: Brasserie Bocuse Irma on the lake is confirmed open for lunch on 25 December in recent years, festive menu €82/€86 per adult — about €220 for four with the children eating à la carte.
blocks.flag: FAR fewer kitchens open on the 25th than the 24th. Book this in November alongside Christmas Eve; fallback Brasserie des Européens (open every day per its site, 04 50 45 00 81).

blocks.title: Basilique de la Visitation — the view
blocks.detail:
• Fifteen minutes uphill from the old town to the basilica on its terrace: the whole lake, the town, the Semnoz above
• Free
• Skip if it is raining

blocks.title: Back at the hotel — Christmas afternoon
blocks.detail:
• Nothing planned
• Goûter at Bar Moxy about 16:15
blocks.flag: OPTIONAL SECOND SEMNOZ: if everyone wants snow on Christmas Day, a 13:00 taxi up and a 16:00 taxi down fits around lunch — swap this block and the basilica for it. About €100 in taxis; the lifts and sledging run on the 25th.

blocks.title: Light supper — Bar Moxy small plates
blocks.detail:
• The hotel bar: small plates and snacks all day
• The Moxy restaurant is closed on the 25th (Tue–Sat only)
blocks.notes: About €40 for four.
blocks.flag: Confirm with the hotel that Bar Moxy serves food on Christmas Day evening. If not: Brasserie Saint Maurice, 9 rue du Collège Chapuisien, continuous service (04 50 51 24 49) — confirm it is trading.

days.title: Annecy — the rink, the old town, one last raclette

blocks.title: Breakfast — Pain et Copains
blocks.detail: • Open Saturday from 06:30

blocks.title: Old town — the last Christmas-market morning
blocks.detail:
• Rue Sainte-Claire, the Palais de l'Isle, the market chalets in daylight
• Free

blocks.title: Lunch — market chalets, Place Saint-Maurice
blocks.detail: • Tartiflette, sausages, crêpes from the chalets — standing tables
blocks.notes: About €35–40 for four.

blocks.title: Bus or taxi to Patinoire Jean Régis
blocks.detail: • 90 chemin des Fins, 2 km north — a €10 taxi, or SIBRA bus from the station (about 10 minutes)

blocks.title: Ice skating — Patinoire Jean Régis
blocks.detail:
• Olympic-size indoor rink with a 'Jardin de Glace' beginners' zone for ages 3–8
• UNDER-5s FREE; adult entry about €4.80, skate hire about €3.50; roughly €25 for four
• Regular Saturday public session 14:00–17:00; holiday hours not yet published — call 04 50 57 56 02
blocks.flag: If the holiday session is at a different time, the market rink in the Jardins de l'Europe is the walk-in fallback.

blocks.title: Back to the hotel
blocks.detail: • Taxi or bus back to the station; five minutes to the Moxy

blocks.title: Goûter — Bar Moxy
blocks.detail: • Hot chocolate and cake downstairs before packing

blocks.title: Pack
blocks.detail:
• Pack tonight, properly, across both rooms. Tomorrow is a five-minute walk and one direct train
• Wet gear into plastic bags

blocks.title: Dinner — Le Fréti, the raclette
blocks.detail:
• 12 rue Sainte-Claire — raclette this time

blocks.notes: About €80 for four. If you would rather try somewhere new: L'Étage, 13 rue du Pâquier, Savoyard with a children's menu and high chairs — prices not published.

days.title: Annecy → Paris CDG — one train, no changes

blocks.title: Breakfast — Pain et Copains
blocks.detail:
• OPEN SUNDAY 07:00–13:00

blocks.notes: About €45 for breakfast and the train lunch together.

blocks.title: Finish packing — no rush
blocks.detail:
• Checkout is 12:00 at the Moxy, so nobody is hauling bags around town

blocks.title: Last look at the lake
blocks.detail:
• Bags stay in the rooms. Pont des Amours and back — forty-five minutes
• Be back at the hotel by 11:30

blocks.title: Checkout — both rooms
blocks.detail:
• Settle the taxe de séjour on both reservations

blocks.title: Annecy station — board
blocks.detail:
• Platform posts about 20 minutes ahead

blocks.title: TGV INOUI 6972 · Annecy → Paris Gare de Lyon
blocks.detail:
• 3h46, DIRECT — zero changes, one seat the whole way
• Runs on Sunday 27 December: confirmed on the published timetable. Fallbacks the same day: 15:29→19:14 and 17:29→21:16
• Domestic TGV, so the Carte Avantage PRICE CAP applies — an adult never pays more than €89, children −60%
blocks.notes: Budgeted at $215 for four. Floor about $150 at advance fares; ceiling about $270 at the cap. Book the moment sales open on 30 September — on an EXCHANGEABLE fare, so a better option appearing in November costs nothing to switch to.
blocks.flag: Sales open 30 September — book that morning, on an exchangeable fare.

blocks.title: Lunch on board — the bakery bag
blocks.detail:
• The bakery sandwiches at your seats

blocks.title: Bar-car break
blocks.detail: • Hot chocolate about €4.50, croissant €2.70

blocks.title: Gare de Lyon — out to the car
blocks.detail:
• PRE-BOOKED car meets you on the concourse with your name on a sign (G7 app, or any Paris transfer firm) — a Sunday TGV full of returning skiers can mean a 20–30 minute rank queue

blocks.title: Taxi · Gare de Lyon → Hyatt House
blocks.detail:
• One car, station door to hotel door
• Ask for a van (monospace) so four people and the winter bags fit in one car
• Say the hotel by name: Hyatt House Paris Charles de Gaulle, rue de la Belle Étoile, Roissy-en-France
• About 28 km, 40–55 minutes on a Sunday afternoon. Roughly €60–75 on the meter; €10–15 more pre-booked

blocks.flag: Cheaper: RER D → Gare du Nord, RER B → CDG, then the hotel shuttle — €42 in fares plus €8 in Navigo Easy cards, about 60 minutes. Worth €16 only if everyone is fresh.

blocks.title: Check in — Hyatt House Paris Charles de Gaulle
blocks.detail:
• Kitchenette-equipped suites, free airport shuttle, about fifteen minutes from the terminals
• CONFIRM the first shuttle departure tomorrow — you need to be at CDG by about 06:40
• Buy tomorrow's early breakfast at the hotel H Market (open 24/7) TONIGHT, before bed
blocks.notes: 15,000 points for the night as given. The $12 is Roissy-en-France tourist tax for two adults, payable at checkout.
blocks.flag: Confirm whether 15,000 covers one room or two. The Paris stay uses two rooms; if this night needs two as well, it is 30,000. Alternative that removes the shuttle entirely: the Sheraton INSIDE Terminal 2, about €195 a room — see the Ideas tab.

blocks.title: Dinner — ZOOM, in the hotel
blocks.detail: • ZOOM serves dinner 18:00–22:00, children's menu €15
blocks.notes: About €70–80 for four. If ZOOM is full or closed: Hippopotamus, 309 rue de la Belle Étoile, 5 minutes on foot, open Sunday to 23:00, children's menu €7.50 — reserve on 01 48 63 18 97.
blocks.flag: Brasserie Le Village in Roissy village is CLOSED at weekends — not an option on a Sunday.

blocks.title: Wake & quick breakfast
blocks.detail:
• Whatever you bought last night, eaten in the room — the hotel breakfast service may not have started
• A proper breakfast is served on board about an hour after take-off

blocks.title: Shuttle to CDG Terminal 2E
blocks.detail:
• Free hotel shuttle, about fifteen minutes
• Confirm the first run at check-in the night before — if it starts later than 06:15, book a taxi instead
blocks.flag: Verify the shuttle's first departure. An airport shuttle that starts at 07:00 does not work for a 9:10 flight.

blocks.title: CDG — check in, security, passport control
blocks.detail:
• Delta departs Terminal 2E

• Two and a half hours is right for a transatlantic with four people and checked bags

blocks.title: Delta 83 · CDG → Atlanta — BOOKED

Duration: 10h15 — 9:10 AM Paris → 1:23 PM Atlanta
Aircraft: not shown on the receipt — check the Fly Delta app

ideas.title: 🗺️ WHY ANNECY — what this version changes, and what it costs you
ideas.detail:
This is the same trip with the six mountain nights moved from Chamonix to Annecy. Paris (17–21), the CDG night (27) and every flight are unchanged.

WHAT YOU GAIN
• ONE DIRECT TRAIN each way. Paris → Annecy 09:46→13:29 on the 21st; Annecy → Paris 12:29→16:15 on the 27th. No Geneva, no border, no coach, no Le Fayet branch line. Both are domestic TGV INOUI, so the Carte Avantage €89 cap applies both ways.
• The 27th ends at the airport hotel at 17:30 instead of 19:30 — dinner at six, kids down by eight, before a 05:30 wake-up.
• Christmas in a proper town: the Noël des Alpes market, an outdoor rink in the gardens, a château, the lake — all on foot from the door.
• Lodging: two Moxy rooms, one on cash (€574, about $680) and one on 166,000 Marriott points plus a Free Night Award — the cash outlay is roughly $690 under Cham sud.
• The snow is cheaper: Semnoz is a €2 city bus with FREE sledging and FREE conveyor lifts.

WHAT YOU GIVE UP
• Waking up in the mountains. Annecy sits at 450 m; snow in town at Christmas is rare. The snow is a bus ride away — about an hour each time.
• Planpraz, Argentière, the Mont-Blanc Express, lunch in Italy through the tunnel — and, in this version, the Mer de Glace. The Chamonix day trip was removed because it was 90 minutes each way on a coach.
• Mont Blanc. You do not see it this week.

THE TRANSPORT HONESTY: by bus, every snow outing from Annecy is an hour or more — Semnoz 60, Le Grand-Bornand 70. So this version has exactly ONE bus day (Le Grand-Bornand, Thursday) and does Semnoz by TAXI — 25 minutes, about €100 for the day. Christmas Day and the 26th are on foot. That is one long ride in six days, not four.

ideas.title: 🏨 LODGING — Moxy Annecy, two rooms, one on points
ideas.detail:
CHOSEN — MOXY ANNECY, 19 avenue du Rhône. Five minutes from the station, five from the old town; check-in 15:00, CHECKOUT 12:00. Rooms are 17 m² with a queen or two twins and a hard maximum of TWO people, so the family takes two twin rooms — one adult and one child in each. Bar Moxy (which is also the front desk) does coffee, cocktails and small plates all day; the restaurant runs Tue–Sat 19:00–21:30. No kitchen, no included breakfast. Marriott 4.1 from 118 reviews.

ROOM 1 — POINTS + FREE NIGHT: nights of 21–25 December on 166,000 Marriott Bonvoy points, and the night of 26 December on a Free Night Award certificate. Two reservations — ask the hotel to link them so nobody changes rooms on the 26th, and confirm the certificate covers a Christmas-week Saturday (Marriott allows a points top-up if it does not).

ROOM 2 — CASH: €574 for all six nights, about $666, plus taxe de séjour of roughly €1.50 per adult per night. Budgeted $680.

WHAT TWO SMALL ROOMS COST YOU: no kitchen (breakfast is the bakery five minutes away, about €20 a morning), no washing machine, no radiators to dry snow gear on (the rooms are climate-controlled units — plan on the hairdryer and the shower rail, and ask the desk for a drying rack), and the family split across two rooms at night. What they buy: a location that beats every apartment on Booking, a 24-hour bar downstairs, a noon checkout, and the points room taking about $680 off the cash total.

THE APARTMENT ALTERNATIVE if you would rather have a kitchen: La Madeleine, 7 rue de l'Annexion, one bedroom plus sofa bed, 431 ft², full kitchen and washing machine, four minutes from the station — $859 refundable before VAT and fees, about $990 all in, Booking 7.9. Cheaper still: Séjours & Affaires Le Pont Neuf in Cran-Gevrier, about $700 all in but a 15–20 minute walk from everything.

ideas.title: 🚄 TRAINS — book on 30 September, exchangeable fares
ideas.detail:
SNCF opens sales for 13 Dec 2026 – 6 Jan 2027 on Wednesday 30 September 2026, about 05:45. Both legs are domestic TGV INOUI — buy ONE Carte Avantage Adulte (€49) first: −30% for the holder and one companion adult, −60% for both children 4–11, and a hard cap of €89 per adult on any domestic TGV.

OUT — Monday 21 December, Paris Gare de Lyon → Annecy, direct. Published: 06:45→10:38, 09:46→13:29 (the plan), 12:46→16:34, 17:46, 18:46.

BACK — Sunday 27 December, TGV INOUI 6972, Annecy → Paris Gare de Lyon 12:29→16:15, direct. Also that day: 08:18→12:15, 15:29→19:14, 17:29→21:16.

Buy EXCHANGEABLE fares on both. Regional timetables and seasonal extras firm up in November; an exchangeable ticket means a better option costs nothing to move to.

Budgeted $215 each way for four — floor about $150 at opening-day fares, ceiling about $270 at the cap.

ideas.title: 🛷 THE SNOW — where, how much, and the one risk
ideas.detail:
LE SEMNOZ (22nd; optional 25th) — 1,450–1,700 m, directly above the lake. FREE toboggan piste with nets and TWO FREE CONVEYOR LIFTS; sledge hire €5 half-day / €8 day at the Nordic Forest chalet; 60 m snow-tubing track from age 3 on a points card (from about €4). Restaurant at the top: Le 1407. Bus S1/S2 from Annecy Gare, about 60 minutes, standard €2 SIBRA fare, DAILY 20 Dec–4 Jan; departures 07:30, 08:30, 09:30, 10:30, 12:00, 13:15; returns 10:40, 11:45, 14:25, 15:45, 16:45, 17:45, 18:15 (2025–26 sheet). REDUCED service on 24 December confirmed for 2025. The plan uses a TAXI instead (25 minutes, roughly €35–55 each way, Taxi74 06 64 12 58 66) so that Semnoz is not an hour each way.

THE SEMNOZ RECORD, since you asked: shut over Christmas in 2018 (closed from 24 Dec — too warm for the new snow cannons) and in 2022 (from 22 Dec, sledging area and its conveyor included, only the baby slope open); opened on time on 16 Dec 2023; opened 21 Dec 2024, partially, 'thanks to recent snowfall'. Two of the last eight winters, and one near miss. Check semnoz.fr's live status the night before; if it is shut, swap Tuesday with the Grand-Bornand day.

LE GRAND-BORNAND (24th) — 1,000 m village, 1,300 m+ at Chinaillon and the top of Rosay. Two FREE sledging areas in the village (La Grenouille at Borne, L'Abeille at Venay) — the 5-year-old needs no lift. Rosay gondola pedestrian ticket €7.70 return per person aged 5+, under-5 free; snow-tubing track at the top (from age 3, price not published); 'La Marmotte' 2,600 m² sledging area at the summit. Bus Y62/Y63 from the gare routière, 1h10, €8.60 single / €16 return adult, child fare not published. Lunch: Pizzeria Casanova, menu enfant €10.

LA CLUSAZ (swap-in) — same bus, one hour. Three free sledging slopes; outdoor rink €6.50 adult / €5 child 5–16, skates €4–5; Pizza Minut has a children's pizza.

SNOW REALITY: at village level (Annecy 450 m, Grand-Bornand 1,000 m) Christmas snow is a coin flip. The Grand-Bornand gondola day happens at 1,300 m+ with snowmaking, where it is not; Semnoz at 1,450–1,700 m is the one with a record.

REMOVED: the Chamonix / Mer de Glace day trip — 90 minutes each way on a coach was the one ride you said you did not want. It can come back as a single long day if you change your mind: BlaBlaCar from the gare routière about 08:30, Montenvers family pass €148.30, first train 10:00.

ideas.title: 🍽️ RESTAURANTS — the short list, with children's prices
ideas.detail:
OLD TOWN, ALL WITHIN SIX MINUTES OF THE APARTMENT
• Le Fréti, 12 rue Sainte-Claire — Savoyard; plat du jour €11–15, menu enfant €12.50. 04 50 51 29 52.
• Le Ramoneur Savoyard, 7 rue Grenette — set menus €21–33.50, menu enfant 'P'tits Malins' €12.90. 04 50 51 29 03.

• La Bolée, 41 rue Carnot — crêperie since 1979. Tue–Sat 11:45–22:30, closed Sun–Mon.
• Brasserie des Européens, Esplanade de l'Hôtel de Ville — open EVERY day. 04 50 45 00 81.
• Brasserie Saint Maurice, 9 rue du Collège Chapuisien — continuous service to 01:00. Trading as 'Petit St Maurice' after a fire; confirm. 04 50 51 24 49.
• Les Burgers de Papa, 11 rue Président Favre — menus from €9.90, two minutes from the door.
• Pain et Copains, 42 rue Vaugelas — bakery, sandwiches €6–7, OPEN SUNDAY 07:00–13:00, closed Monday.

CHRISTMAS EVE / DAY (from the annecy-ville.fr lists for 2024 and 2025 — re-check the November 2026 list)
• Ô Bon Bec — 24 Dec, €110 adult / €45 child 5–11 / under-5 free. The only one with a published child price.
• Le Clocher, Annecy-le-Vieux — 24 Dec, €68, five courses, whole table on the same menu.
• Brasserie Bocuse Irma, lakeside — 24 Dec evening AND 25 Dec lunch, €82/€86.
• The Craic — 24 Dec, €85.
• Everything books out. Reserve in November.

SUPERMARKETS
• Carrefour City, 14 av de Chambéry — Mon–Sat 07:00–20:50, SUNDAY 09:00–12:50. Three minutes from the door.
• Monoprix, 65 rue Carnot — Mon–Sat 08:30–20:45, closed Sunday.

NONE of these have published 24–26 December hours for 2026. Call each one you are counting on in early December.

ideas.title: 💰 BUDGET — what this version does to the number
ideas.detail:
Same Paris, same flights, same CDG night. The Annecy week replaces the Chamonix week roughly like this:

CHEAPER
• Lodging: one Moxy room on cash at €574 (about $680), the other on 166,000 Marriott points plus a Free Night Award — against Cham sud at $1,370. About −$690 in cash.
• The Chamonix day trip is gone: no BlaBlaCar (−$100), no Montenvers (−$172).
• Courmayeur is gone (−$266 in bus, park and Italian lunch), replaced by Le Grand-Bornand at about $145 — net about −$120.
• Transport out: one domestic TGV ($215) instead of Lyria plus the Geneva coach ($267).
• Christmas Day is the Savoyard lunch and a light supper, not a €55–90-a-head evening.

DEARER
• Semnoz by taxi instead of the €2 bus: about +$100 for the day.
• Breakfast out at the bakery instead of a kitchen: about +$60 across the week.

The build's own total is printed in the Money tab, and this is the first version of the trip that lands UNDER the $5,000 cap in cash. The 166,000 Marriott points and the Free Night Award are the price of that.

ideas.title: ⚠ TRIP-BREAKER — Leavenworth collision
ideas.detail: This trip is Dec 16–28, 2026. Leavenworth Winter 2026 is Dec 19–27, 2026 with MIA→SEA booked on Dec 19 (Alaska AS305, conf UUKHNQ) and a Hampton Inn on 308K Hilton points. They overlap by eight days and both depart from Miami. These cannot both happen. Nothing here should be booked until one of them moves.

ideas.title: 🛏️ THE LAST NIGHT — Hyatt House vs the Sheraton inside Terminal 2
ideas.detail:
The plan keeps the Hyatt House (15,000 points, free shuttle, 05:30 wake-up for a 06:15 shuttle). With the Annecy routing you are there by 17:30, so the early night is comfortable and the points stay the better deal.

If you would rather remove the shuttle altogether: the Sheraton Paris Airport is BUILT INTO TERMINAL 2 with indoor access to the Delta check-in — walk downstairs at 06:30. About €195 a room, and the hotel will not take four in one room, so two rooms: roughly $425 cash for the night. The regulated €56 taxi flat fare from Gare de Lyon applies to it, since it is at the airport itself.
